thread:
Anika: Quick sync—we're launching a seed-credit matrix next week tied to the webinar RSVP + prompt templates. Need final trigger rules, copy, and measurements.
Matt: Love this. Proposal: 50 credits for webinar registrants who finish the onboarding tutorial, 25 for RSVP-only. Measure day3 activation. Thoughts?
Jia: Is 50 too high for self-serve? Suggest 30 for registrants, 10 for RSVP-only. Also push a prompt-template CTA inside onboarding to drive usage.
Leo: Agree on CTA test. Recommend A/B on copy: "Try 50 credits" vs "Get started with curated prompts". Landing -> /quickstart?utm=seed
Anika: @Matt can you update the trigger matrix and add GA events? I put a doc here: https://docs.google.com/seed-trigger-matrix (will share edit access)
Matt: Updated the sheet. Quick snippet of the rule I'm proposing:
```
trigger:
  event: signup_complete
  cohort: webinar_registrant
  credit: 30
  expiry_days: 14
```
Jia: Also require ONE prompt-template run to unlock the full credit amount to reduce abuse. If not completed, grant a smaller trial (10).
Olivia: Support note — need a short runbook for credits failing to apply + common error messages. I'll draft and attach to the doc.
deploy-bot: experiment created: seed-credit-v12, start=2160090000, metric=day3_activation_rate
Anika: Great — next steps: design for the launch post (small gif showing prompt templates in action). @Leo can you loop in @Design? Will demo in Monday standup.
